notes: Reviewed and returned unchanged; only the notes on s002 and s008 were sharpened, no edge or head was altered.
Every s### and t### id is partitioned exactly once: 11 source and 15 target tokens all accounted for, no invented ids.

The one materially contestable unit is s002. *of you* could be read as `added` on the ASV's italics, or *you* could be hung on γίνεσθε's 2nd-person inflection under rule 9. Rule 11 makes the markup evidence rather than a verdict, and the partitive slot is the quantifier's, not the verb's subject slot, so it rides with πολλοί under rules 7 and 27. Both competing readings are now named in the unit's note per rule 16.

Head choices reviewed independently of edges per rule 28: s011 heads on *receive* and not on the auxiliary *shall* or the subject *we*; s002 heads on *many* and not on the supplied partitive. Rules 66 and 91 are not in question, since no one Greek word is rendered by an adjective-plus-noun phrase here.

Atomization checked against rule 26: μεῖζον κρίμα is split into *heavier* / *judgment*, and πολλοὶ διδάσκαλοι into *many* / *teachers*, both being independently recoverable. No article stands anywhere in the verse, so rules 19-23, 31-32 and 89 raise nothing.
